changes.text: DeCAL dataset: 1,279 bimanual trajectories (1,989,891 frames, 13 tasks) on two Sharpa Wave hands with per-fingertip 6-D contact vectors and 240x240 deformation images; public on ModelScope in Open-X-Tactile format, 2.0 TB, Apache-2.0 on the card.
TipDex-VTLA demonstrations: 300 teleoperated demonstrations of 4 tasks on two Inspire RH56F2-E2-T1 hands with 364 piezoresistive taxels each; release announced in the paper.

BVT-20: 44.2 h of bimanual glove touch (290 taxels per hand) from 22 participants over 20 coordination tasks; the paper says it is released, but its anonymous project page returned 404, so availability is announced.

Talos electrician conduit and subpanel sample: three free episodes (306 s) with Talos gloves on both hands (10 FSR pads and 12 IMUs each) and head-mounted stereo video with depth; the 45-minute job is sold separately.

TouchTwin: rebuilds TouchScale glove recordings in MuJoCo with the 880-taxel touch setting each finger's contact and closing force, and generates perturbed demonstrations with simulated contact and force labels; no code release stated.
TouchAnnotator: predicts 21x21 per-hand pressure and contact from egocentric video, trained on EgoTouch, HumanTouch, T-Rex and three bare-hand sets; MIT code and a 9.40 GB checkpoint are public.
VisTacAlign: co-trains an ORCA Hand v2 policy (363 Hall taxels) on robot data and 202-taxel glove demonstrations with mapped per-finger force; code marked coming soon.
DeCAL: VLA for two Sharpa Wave hands that takes fingertip deformation maps and forces and predicts future tactile latents in training; Apache-2.0 code public, no trained checkpoint linked.
TipDex-VTLA: VTLA policy on Inspire RH56F2-E2-T1 hands that compares forecast and measured touch to refine unexecuted actions; code and data announced.
BiView-Touch: tactile-only encoder pretrained on HumanTouch by completing one masked hand region from the rest of that hand and the other hand; evaluated on BVT-20.
HACo: compliant-action policy for two Sharpa hands from fingertip wrenches, deformation maps and 44 joint torques; 83% mean success over five tasks; Apache-2.0 code public, no checkpoint.
STAR: VTLA training recipe on pi0.5 using 200 h of bimanual data from hands with 268 piezoresistive taxels each; no code, weights or data release stated.
